segments.oily: The one reviewer who mentions oily, acne-prone skin alongside her sensitivity reports it gently buffs away dead skin without over-stripping.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it exfoliates without over-drying and restores softness, including some switching from the brand's more abrasive original formula; one reviewer with dry skin at 48 notes mild stinging around the eyes if she uses it daily instead of a few times a week.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin reports it protects her skin barrier and leaves no dryness.
segments.sensitive: An unusually large share of reviewers describe their skin as sensitive, including many with rosacea, eczema, or psoriasis, and report this is the first exfoliant that doesn't irritate them; this is by far the most consistent, most positive theme in the reviews.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s and 50s report soft, smooth skin, with one describing no wrinkles or dryness at mid-50s.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including many with dry skin, report the product does not strip or dry the skin, several specifically praising it as gentler than Dermalogica's original, more abrasive exfoliant. A few note mild exceptions: one gets stinging around the eyes if she uses it daily rather than as directed, and another is unsure whether mild dryness she noticed came from the product or seasonal weather.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or redness-prone skin consistently report calmer, less red skin and no irritation with regular use; no reviewer in this set reports the product increasing redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers specifically credit the product with not disrupting their skin barrier, unlike other exfoliants they have used. One reviewer cautions that using it daily rather than the recommended few-times-a-week can still disrupt the barrier and trigger breakouts.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers report brighter, more even-looking skin, including one who specifically mentions improvement in dullness and hyperpigmentation; this is not the main focus of most reviews.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including some managing active acne, report clearer skin and fewer breakouts with regular, moderate use. One reviewer (2 stars), however, reports significantly more acne after using it, an experience she says her sister shared; another cautions that overusing it can itself trigger breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports a visible reduction in sebaceous filaments after a week of use; this is not a focus of most reviews.
